idea: How to maintain a water tank
title: Essential Steps to Maintain Your Home Water Storage Tank
description: Regular maintenance of your home water storage tank ensures clean water and prevents unexpected system breakdowns. Over time, sediment and mineral deposits settle at the bottom, while float valves can wear out and cause costly overflows. Inspect your tank at least once a year. Shut off the incoming water supply, drain the tank through its dedicated drain line, and gently scrub the interior walls with clean water and a soft-bristle brush. Always check the mechanical float valve to ensure it shuts off completely when raised. Flush remaining debris thoroughly before refilling. If you spot cracked pipes or faulty valves, consult a licensed professional plumber.
